problem_statement: Ledger gateway v1 (`post_transfer`) is being retired at the end of the quarter, so `UpstreamWorker.disburse_tranche` has to move to the v2 `submit()` API. Please migrate it following the pattern in `reference/` (see `reference/MIGRATION.md`). With v2 the outcome should carry the receipt reference and the receipt status (`settled` or `pending`) instead of the generic `disbursed`. The test suite was already switched to the v2 ledger fake and is currently failing. Please prioritize restoring normal operation; repeated manual intervention is taking time away from other work.
